title: Liga UNDER — Tournament Web App
description: *Liga UNDER* is a **live tournament website** for a taekwondo competition (Cadet and Junior, Premià de Mar, June 2026). Spectators and athletes follow the running order of combats by tatami, the standings of each round-robin group, and every athlete's profile — updating in near real time during the event.

Generated end-to-end by **Claude**. A shared **Google Sheet is the database**: assistants edit results live, and the browser reads the sheet directly through the public **gviz endpoint** (no server, no API key), polling for changes. The site computes all standings, league points, and cross-tables itself, and ships in **Catalan, Spanish, and English**.

Built as static files for free **GitHub Pages** hosting, with a pure, unit-tested scoring engine and a graceful live-data pipeline (keeps the last good data, pauses when the tab is hidden). See ADR 0008 for the sheet-as-database decision.
